headline: Huawei maps 1.4nm-class chips by 2031; a quiet day
body: A quiet day. Huawei laid out a roadmap to 1.4nm-class chip density by 2031 despite export controls, a small push to Capability Velocity that slightly lifts Enslaved God and Descendants and trims Reversion. Spain approved a draft AI law aligned with the EU AI Act. Horizon Balance is unchanged at 0.9.
movers_note: Reversion -0.1, from Huawei's chip roadmap (-0.13). Gatekeeper +0.1, mostly from Huawei's chip roadmap (+0.09) and Spain's draft AI law (+0.03). Enslaved God +0.1, from Huawei's chip roadmap (+0.13), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.04).
